question: In Mobmouth (note: abbreviation for Idolmaster Cinderella Girls?), there’s an idol named Haruna Kamijo (nicknamed Megakichi) who preaches about glasses, but I guess she’s Mr. Cat’s natural enemy.
answer: I don’t know if it’s all the same person hitting me with questions about glasses, but over the last two or three days, I’ve come to dislike characters with glasses. My current natural enemy isn’t characters with glasses, it’s people who ask questions about glasses.
